Definition: from the alternate of G4098; a ruin, i.e. (specially), lifeless body (corpse, carrion):--dead body, carcase, corpse.
BiblicalUsage: Ptoma means a fallen body, a corpse, a carcass. When John's disciples heard of his death, they came and took up his corpse and laid it in a tomb, and Jesus says, Wheresoever the carcase is, there will the eagles be gathered together. And the two witnesses' dead bodies shall lie in the street of the great city, which spiritually is called Sodom and Egypt.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the dead body is the Bible's picture of judgment: John's corpse was honoured by his disciples, but the carcass the eagles gather is a warning to the living.
RelatedPeople: John the Baptist; Jesus; John the Apostle
